Bauwa vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 20
February, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 13
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1969 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Bauwa
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Civil Sectt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anoop Srivastava
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Counter affidavit filed by the State as well as by the informant/complainant is taken on record.

Heard Shri Neeraj Singh, learned counsel for the accused-applicant; Shri Anoop Srivastava-II,
learned counsel appearing for the informant/complainant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Bauwa for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 378 of 2022, under Sections 380, 376 & 354 I.P.C., Police Station- Kotwali, District- Unnao, during trial.

Learned counsel for the applicant while drawing the attention of this Court towards an F.I.R. which has been lodged by the real sister of the instant applicant- Bauwa on 17.04.2022 at Police Station- Kotwali, District- Unnao against the husband of the informant/victim of the instant case, namely,
Sanjay Singh under Sections 354 & 506 I.P.C. vehemently submits that the instant F.I.R. against the applicant is nothing but the counterblast of the same as the real sister of the applicant was not only molested but raped by the husband of the victim of instant case and after investigation charge sheet Bauwa vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165983454/
1 amongst other under Section 376 I.P.C. was also submitted therein and only to create pressure on the applicant to withdraw that case or to make compromise, the instant F.I.R. has been lodged.

It is further submitted that though, a written application has been given in the instant case by the victim/informant and there is no allegation of rape therein and the allegations which have been levelled are only pertaining to the molestation, however, the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. had improved her version to the tune that the applicant is also committed rape on her which in the facts and circumstances of the case could not be believed.
It is also submitted that the age of the prosecutrix as per her statement given under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C is 45 and 43 years respectively, and the informant was also not subjected to medical examination.
It is next submitted that applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 23.11.2022 and he is not having any criminal history.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

It is also submitted that in the cross case lodged by the sister of the applicant against the husband of the victim of the instant case namely, Sanjay Singh has been granted the facility of anticipatory bail.
There is no apprehension that after being released on bail he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.

Shri Anoop Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant/complainant also vehemently opposes the prayer of the applicant on the ground that the manner in which the sexual assault has been committed on the prosecutrix/victim was such that the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

He further submits that the victim has also been subjected to medical examination, however,
the same might have not been included by the investigating officer in the case diary and keeping in view the heinousness of the crime, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it appears to be an admitted case that pertaining to incident allegedly occurred on 09.03.2022, the first information report was lodged by the real sister of applicant- Bauwa against the husband of the victim of the instant case namely, Sanjay Singh, on 17.04.2022 at Police Station- Kotwali, District- Unnao pertaining to the sexual assault committed on the sister of the applicant and it is stated that after investigation, charge sheet has already been filed therein and the husband of the victim of the instant case has been granted the facility of the anticipatory bail.
The F.I.R. of the instant case has been lodged on 21.05.2022 wherein only allegation of molestation has been levelled and there is no whisper about commission of sexual assault (Rape).

Significantly, though, the first information report was lodged on 21.05.2022 but the statement of the prosecutrix under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
could only be recorded on 15.07.2022 for the reasons best known to the investigating officer of the Bauwa vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165983454/
2 case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The age of the prosecutrix as stated by her in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. is 45 and 43 years respectively.

The filming of an obscene video and blackmailing the informant/victim with regard to that has also been alleged, however, no video of any kind is shown to have been recovered during the course of investigation.
Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 23.11.2022 without any criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed and the presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicant- Bauwa involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.

Order Date :- 20.2.2023 G.Singh  Bauwa vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165983454/
